// diagnostic

E0163

Increment and decrement can't target an indexed slot.

What

Increment and decrement can't target an indexed slot.

Why

An indexed read can panic when a map key is missing, so the update needs a default value.

Fix

Write a total update, such as `map[key] = (map.get(key) ?? 0) {op} 1`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0163: tests/ui/incr_index_target.stderr.

Error [E0163]: increment and decrement can't target an indexed slot.
  --> tests/ui/incr_index_target.jet:4:7
    |
  4 |     xs[0]++
    |       ^^^
 Why: an indexed read can panic when a map key is missing, so the update needs a default value.
 Fix: write a total update, such as `map[key] = (map.get(key) ?? 0) + 1`
